title: Metrics files report cost_usd = 0 despite token usage visible in thinking blocks
description: All observed metrics files contain cost_usd = 0 (or the field is absent). However, token usage and associated cost is visible in the thinking block traces attached to runs. The cost extraction step in the metrics-writing phase is either reading from the wrong source, the extraction logic is not implemented, or the metrics schema does not map to the field that actually contains cost data from the MCP session. This means cost tracking and budget regression detection are non-functional.
proposed_resolution:
1. Identify where token/cost data is available in the MCP session context (likely in the run completion event or the query_agent response metadata).
2. Update the metrics-writing step in all canonical skills to extract actual cost_usd from that source.
3. Add a test that asserts cost_usd > 0 for any run that produced thinking blocks.
4. Verify the rolling-average cost regression check in the reviewer actually fires when cost exceeds threshold.
